roleDescriptions.T2IAA_M: User in charge of defining and changing the onboarding procedure itself, such as setting up the mandatory documents and the rules followed by the onboarding process.
roleDescriptions.NOTARY: Tier 2 authorisation operator, in charge of handling onboarding requests and following up on them. Can request further documents, comment on the requests and approve or reject them.
roleDescriptions.ONBOARDER_M: Tier 2 setup administrator, in charge of finalising the Tier 2 setup of an agent installation.
roleDescriptions.IATTR_M: Role present only in the Dataspace Governance Authority. It covers the whole lifecycle of identity attributes, from creation and management to assignment to participants.
roleDescriptions.T1UAR_M: Tier 1 user and roles manager. Manages local roles and dataspace identity attributes: defines them and assigns them to participant types, determining their assignability.
roleDescriptions.APPLICANT: End user who manages onboarding requests for dataspace participants signing up through the public dataspace onboarding site. Creates onboarding requests and responds to Tier 2 (NOTARY) authorisation interactions until approval.
roleDescriptions.Ro-MU-CA: Role defined in the XFSC Federated Catalogue: Catalogue Administrator.
roleDescriptions.Ro-MU-A: Role defined in the XFSC Federated Catalogue: Participant Administrator.
roleDescriptions.Ro-SD-A: Role defined in the XFSC Federated Catalogue: Self-Description Administrator.
roleDescriptions.Ro-Pa-A: Role defined in the XFSC Federated Catalogue: Participant User Administrator.
roleDescriptions.SD_PUBLISHER: Role for the user responsible for creating and publishing the self-description on the catalogue.
roleDescriptions.SD_CONSUMER: Tier 1 role for the data consumer.
roleDescriptions.GA_SCHEMA_ADMIN: Schema Manager administrator. Tier 1 role for schema administration.
roleDescriptions.GA_SCHEMA_VIEWER: Schema Manager viewer. Tier 1 role for schema consultation.
roleDescriptions.KIBANA_BUSINESS_USER: Kibana business user. Grants access to Kibana as a business user (bound to a local Kibana user).
roleDescriptions.KIBANA_ADMIN: Kibana administrator. Grants access to Kibana as an administrator (bound to a local Kibana user).
roleDescriptions.ORCH_DEVELOPER: Data orchestration developer. Allows developing workflows and services for data orchestration.
roleDescriptions.ORCH_ADMIN: Data orchestration administrator. Administers and manages the orchestration: scheduling, workflow retries and monitoring.
roleDescriptions.INFRA_ADMIN: Infrastructure provider administrator. Manages all the infrastructure provider's cloud resources.
roleDescriptions.INFRA_DEPLOYER: Infrastructure provider deployer. Activates and deactivates the infrastructure provider's cloud resources.
roleDescriptions.G-Administrator: Governance Authority administrator. Manages and administers the whole dataspace.
roleDescriptions.G-Content Editor: Governance Authority content editor. Manages the content of the public portal.
roleDescriptions.G-Operator: Governance Authority operator. Responsible for the day-to-day operational management of the dataspace.
roleDescriptions.G-Portal Manager: Governance Authority portal manager. Manages the public portal, both its structure and its content.
roleDescriptions.G-Tech Operator: Governance Authority technical operator. Responsible for operating and maintaining the technical infrastructure of the dataspace.
roleDescriptions.P-Connector Administrator: Participant connector administrator. Installs and manages the participant's EDNEL connectors, and appoints the participant's user administrator.
roleDescriptions.P-Data Consumer: Participant data consumer. Can browse and search the asset catalogue and consume free data while complying with the applicable policies.
roleDescriptions.P-Data Offer Manager: Participant data offer manager. Defines the policies and the pricing of the participant's assets and creates the offers.
roleDescriptions.P-Data Provider: Participant data provider. Creates, edits and deletes the metadata of the participant's assets.
roleDescriptions.P-Financial Administrator: Participant financial administrator. Handles the financial operations: invoicing and payment management.
roleDescriptions.P-Legal Representative: Person appointed by the participating entity to request participation in EDNEL and to act as its legal representative, for instance as the point of contact with the Governance Authority.
roleDescriptions.P-User Administrator: Participant user administrator. Manages the participant's users: creates, edits and deactivates them and assigns them roles, except for the P-Legal Representative and P-Connector Administrator roles.
